Respected Sir/Madam,

In accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time, we hereby inform you that Mr. Sankara Subramaniam Ramnath (DIN: 00067019), Independent Director of Brisk Technovision Limited ("the Company"), has submitted his resignation from the position of Independent Director effective from the close of business hours on November 27, 2026. 

The details required under Regulation 30 - Part A of Para A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 are enclosed as an Annexures to this letter.

You are requested to take the same on your record.

MORE:
The Board of Directors of Brisk Technovision Limited, at its meeting held on November 27, 2026, has considered and approved the following matters:
1. Took note of the resignation of Mr. Sankara Subramaniam Ramnath as Independent Director, effective from the close of business hours on November 27, 2026.
2. Approved the change in designation of Mr. Ganapati Chittaranjan Kenkare from Managing Director to Executive Director & CEO, effective November 27, 2026.
3. Approved the appointment of Mr. Rajesh Arjun Dharira as Managing Director for a period of five years, from November 27, 2026 to November 26, 2031, subject to shareholders'' approval.
4. Approved the appointment of Mr. Vishal Agrawal as Additional Director in the capacity of Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 27, 2026, subject to shareholders'' approval, wherever applicable.
The Board Meeting commenced at 11:05 AM (IST) and concluded at 11:40 AM (IST).
